note: Triennial election of the 16 electoral divisions of Clogher rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. There was no contest: eleven Unionists and five Nationalists were nominated (Ulster Herald, 21 May 1949, p. 5, which names the five new members). All sixteen members are recorded; the eleven others come from the Returning Officer's Notice of Result, dated 23 May 1949 (Impartial Reporter, 26 May 1949, p. 8). New Nationalist member. Returned unopposed.
